limitations: Custom mapping and colors, not the default install appearance
Synthetic events do not prove a live provider lifecycle
Owned-window composition, not a full desktop compositor screenshot
Input demonstration does not prove a completed conversation
The response-history README composition is source-runtime synthetic QA, not a provider conversation or frozen-release proof.
